# n5 - INDEX as a projection of the ledgers

`IndexProjection.analyze(store_path)` computes every intent's status from its own `savepoint.md`
ledger, reads the status INDEX.md currently claims, and returns both plus the drift between them.
The ledger wins where the ledger speaks (D7 as restated at the plan review): an intent whose ledger
is absent or silent keeps the status INDEX carries. This node computes and compares only; it
writes nothing.

## n5 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 5.1 | Read an intent's status from its ledger's last terminal line | The projection reads the first terminal line instead of the last, so a reopened and re-closed intent reports the disposition it had two closes ago | `index_projection_test#test_status_comes_from_the_last_terminal_ledger_line` |
| 5.2 | Map `Done delivered` to Completed and `Done abandoned` to Abandoned | An abandoned intent is projected as delivered, and the store's record of what shipped becomes false | `index_projection_test#test_delivered_and_abandoned_map_to_their_own_sections` |
| 5.3 | Project an intent with no terminal line as Active | An in-flight intent is projected as delivered on the strength of a stage line, and the drift report tells the owner to close work that is still running | `index_projection_test#test_intent_without_a_terminal_line_projects_active` |
| 5.4 | Handle an intent directory with no `savepoint.md` | The projection raises, so one unscaffolded directory takes down the report for the whole store | `index_projection_test#test_intent_without_a_savepoint_is_reported_unknown_not_raised` |
| 5.5 | Treat INDEX's Future section as INDEX-only | Every Future intent is reported as drift because no ledger can express Future, and the report becomes noise nobody reads | `index_projection_test#test_future_intents_are_not_reported_as_drift` |
| 5.6 | Exclude a torn ledger line from the status | A crash-truncated line is read as a terminal state and an unfinished intent is projected as closed | `index_projection_test#test_torn_ledger_line_is_excluded_from_the_projection` |
| 5.7 | Survive an invalid UTF-8 byte in a ledger | `ArgumentError: invalid byte sequence` takes down the projection and the doctor rule that calls it | `index_projection_test#test_invalid_utf8_byte_does_not_raise` |
| 5.8 | Report an INDEX entry with no store directory | The projection crashes, or quietly drops the entry, on an id INDEX lists that no directory backs | `index_projection_test#test_index_entry_without_a_directory_is_reported` |
| 5.9 | Report a store directory INDEX does not list | An intent that exists on disk is invisible to the report, which is the drift most worth catching | `index_projection_test#test_directory_missing_from_index_is_reported` |
| 5.10 | Report drift with both sides named | The finding says only that something disagrees, so the owner cannot tell which side to fix without reading the store by hand | `index_projection_test#test_drift_row_names_the_index_status_and_the_ledger_status` |
| 5.11 | Write nothing | The comparison rewrites the store's spine as a side effect of being read, which is the one outcome D7 forbids | `index_projection_test#test_analyze_writes_no_file` |
| 5.12 | Honour the doctor exclusions the store already carries | Excluded directories are reported as drift on every run, and the exclusion mechanism the store already has is defeated. Folded at review (A6, D14): the exclusions read are the existing `savepoint_operational` and `backfilled_complete` keys, never a new one, because `RuleCatalog::EXCLUDABLE_CHECKS` is pinned verbatim by `rule_catalog_test` | `index_projection_test#test_excluded_directories_are_skipped` |
| 5.13 | Keep the INDEX status when the ledger is silent or absent | Folded at review (A4, D7): 63 of 451 intents in the plastic store have no `savepoint.md` and 59 more stop before a `Done` line. A literal reading of the ledger classifies all 103 as Active, and applied by the writer it demotes 103 Completed intents and destroys the store's spine | `index_projection_test#test_silent_or_absent_ledger_keeps_the_index_status` |
| 5.14 | Classify a `Done` line whose detail is not exactly a disposition | Folded at review (A5): across the stores, 11 real `Done` lines carry details such as `delivered (merge 6e2b2ca to ma...)` and `merged to main at 690c696 ...`. Under a strict equality match every one of them projects Active, and eleven closed intents are reported as in flight | `index_projection_test#test_done_detail_is_classified_by_prefix_or_reported_indeterminate` |
| 5.15 | Report the drift totals the owner will actually see | Folded at review (C2): the real store yields about 130 findings, of which roughly 103 are already `savepoint_operational`'s. A report that repeats an existing finding at that volume is trained out of attention on its first run | `index_projection_test#test_drift_rows_exclude_what_savepoint_operational_already_reports` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code in this node.
2. Write the code that makes them pass.
3. Green, then `ruby bin/test` at its baseline before the next node starts.
